title: A football team's win probability
intro:
Illustrative data, made up for this book: the sizes and patterns are realistic, the teams and players are not real. An American-football team trails by 3 points with 12 minutes left. Model the final margin as normal with mean −3 (the current margin) and standard deviation 13.5 × √(12/60) = 6.04 points.

Give the team's win probability P(final margin > 0) and its z-score of 0 (four decimals).

In the Workbench: **Continuous distribution**, **Normal**, mean −3, standard deviation 6.04, **Value of interest** 0.

MoreThan.says: That is P(margin ≤ 0), the chance of losing. The win probability is P(margin > 0).
